name: wsb-post-classifier
removed_classes: the catch-all fifth class was removed on purpose; it is not part of this model

provenance.note: byte-identical copy of the best checkpoint from the training run in logreg_hand/. Not refit, not retrained, not re-parameterised.

estimator.why_sgd: sklearn >= 1.7 removed learning_rate/eta0 from LogisticRegression (they only ever applied to the sag/saga solvers). SGDClassifier with loss='log_loss' is the same logistic objective with a fixed step size, so lr=0.01 is honoured literally.

features.note: FeatureUnion fitted on the 80% train split only; the held-out 20% was never seen by the vectorizer or the classifier

training_data.split: 80% train (6400) / 20% held-out test (1600), stratified on (year, label), seed 42
training_data.labelling: every post read by hand against LABEL_RUBRIC.md; no model-generated or keyword-generated labels

metrics.note: these are this exact checkpoint's own scores: it was trained on the 80% split only, so the 20% is a genuine held-out set for it. Reproducible via smoke_test.py.

why_this_checkpoint.summary: logreg_lr0.01_bal was best on 3 of the 4 recorded metrics; the logreg_lbfgs reference only edged it on CV macro-F1, by less than one standard deviation.
why_this_checkpoint.cv5_macro_f1: 0.6373 vs 0.6487 for lbfgs - second, gap 0.0114 < 1 std (0.0139)
why_this_checkpoint.also: it is the lr=0.01 configuration that was requested as primary, not a side reference

alternates_in_models_dir.logreg_lr0.01_raw.joblib: same lr=0.01 but no class_weight - collapses toward NOISE_MEME, macro-F1 0.5548
alternates_in_models_dir.logreg_lr0.001_bal.joblib: lr=0.001, undertrained at 300 epochs (train acc 0.84), macro-F1 0.6024
alternates_in_models_dir.logreg_lbfgs.joblib: LogisticRegression lbfgs C=4 balanced reference - best CV macro-F1 (0.6487)
alternates_in_models_dir.training_results.json: the full metrics.json the selection was made from

known_weaknesses: GENUINE_OPINION is the weakest class (F1 0.42): a directional opinion with no analysis is hard to separate from a joke using text alone
2019-2023 posts in Arctic Shift often have an empty body, so those years are classified from the title alone
accuracy is dominated by NOISE_MEME (58% of data); use macro-F1 or per-class metrics to judge changes to this model
the model overfits: train accuracy 0.958 vs 0.711 on held-out data
